free_tier.stated: VPS Linux 1 on the vendor's own KVM page: 1 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 20 GB disk, KVM virtualisation, 1 public IPv4, and a traffic line that states the traffic is unlimited. The monthly price on the card is 8,625.00 Kz (Angolan kwanza); the same card offers 24,600.00 Kz quarterly, 46,560.00 Kz semiannual and 87,975.00 Kz annual, and the order button carries the order label rather than the unavailable label. The tracker prices this plan at EUR 5.00 per month with 5,000 GB a month on a 0.1 Gbps port in Angola; the vendor page states no euro price, no monthly byte allowance and no port speed. Re-read 2026-11-07: the card still shows 8.625,00 Kz monthly and its price attribute still holds 87.975,00 Kz annual, 46.560,00 Kz semiannual and 24.600,00 Kz quarterly with -1 on the triennial and biennial terms, the cycle tabs 'Trimestralmente Poupe 5 %', 'Semestralmente Poupe 5 %' and '1-Ano Poupe 15 %', and the order button 'Encomendar ja!'. Add-to-cart for pid 183 resolves with status 200 on both the monthly and the annual cycle, landing on the configurator and then the checkout step with no out-of-stock marker, so the plan is in stock. No page read prints a renewal price. The configurator and checkout pages render prices client-side and in kwanza, which the cart-read tool's price scan does not cover; it found no price string on either cart page, so the cart-rendered price is unverified.
